steps.title: THE TRACK
steps.text: Metal orbs roll along this track toward the endpoint.

steps.title: YOUR HEALTH
steps.text: Health starts at 100 / 100 and remains fixed in the HUD.

steps.title: ESCAPED ORBS
steps.text: Every orb that escapes removes Health Points based on its tier.

steps.title: METAL CURRENCY
steps.text: Destroy orbs to earn metal currency for towers and upgrades.

steps.title: WATER ELEPHANT
steps.text: The Water Elephant is the recommended first purchase because it can defend the track. A Papaya Plant also costs 100, but buying one first is a risky economy strategy because it cannot attack.

steps.title: BUY WATER ELEPHANT
steps.text: Buy a Water Elephant for 100 currency.

steps.title: CHOOSE VALID GROUND
steps.text: Place towers outside the track and away from occupied ground.

steps.title: ATTACK RADIUS
steps.text: The circle previews attack range. Green is valid and red is blocked.

steps.title: PLACE THE ELEPHANT
steps.text: Place your Water Elephant here so it can reach the track.

steps.title: STARTER GIFT
steps.text: You received a free starter Water Elephant. The highlighted ground inside the large U bend covers three nearby track sections. It is recommended, but you may place the gift on any valid ground.

steps.title: START WAVE 1
steps.text: Launch Wave 1 when both elephants are placed and your defense is ready.

steps.title: AUTOMATIC TARGETING
steps.text: Elephants automatically face and spray valid orbs inside their range.

steps.title: DAMAGED ORBS SPEED UP
steps.text: As normal orbs lose HP, they gain up to 20% movement speed.

steps.title: DESTRUCTION REWARDS
steps.text: Defeated orbs crack apart, then send a gold reward light to your currency.

steps.title: ENCYCLOPEDIA LIGHT
steps.text: A first defeat also sends a magical knowledge light to the encyclopedia.

steps.title: SELECT YOUR ELEPHANT
steps.text: Select the elephant you placed to inspect its statistics.

steps.title: UPGRADES
steps.text: Every elephant has five total levels. Each upgrade improves damage, speed, and range.

steps.title: SCALING COSTS
steps.text: Successive upgrades cost more, so plan each investment.

steps.title: SELLING
steps.text: Selling refunds only 50% of the original purchase price. Upgrades never increase it.

steps.title: GAME SPEED
steps.text: Cycle between 1×, 1.5×, and 2× without multiplying any timer twice.

steps.title: WAVE CONTROL
steps.text: Start waves manually or enable Auto for a three-second warning before the next launch.

steps.title: MORE TRACK BELOW
steps.text: The track continues below. Scroll down to see the rest of the map.

steps.title: YOU'RE READY!
steps.text: Build carefully, scroll into the lower foundry, and defend through Wave 50.
